# Anne Shirley

## Overview

- **Age:** Eleven years old when first arriving at Green Gables  <sub>[v1 c6 P17](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0017)</sub>
- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 c22 P10](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0010)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  <sub>[v5 c1 P1](../source/v05-c01.md#nw-v05-c01-p0001), [v5 c1 P3](../source/v05-c01.md#nw-v05-c01-p0003)</sub>
- **Origin:** Avonlea / Prince Edward Island  <sub>[v3 c4 P31](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0031)</sub>
- **Role:** Teacher  <sub>[v2 c4 P1](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0001), [v3 c31 P1](../source/v03-c31.md#nw-v03-c31-p0001)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Cordelia  <sub>[v1 c3 P19](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0019)</sub>

## Appearance

Anne has gray-green eyes, a little pointed chin, and a nice nose. Her bright red hair was dyed green in a failed experiment and subsequently clipped short before growing back. As a grown woman and mother, she retains her girlish look and the unquenchable dream in her eyes.

_Sources: [v1 c13 P1](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0001), [v1 c15 P13](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0013), [v1 c15 P32](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0032), [v1 c27 P16](../source/v01-c27.md#nw-v01-c27-p0016), [v1 c27 P40](../source/v01-c27.md#nw-v01-c27-p0040), [v3 c4 P56](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0056), [v5 c1 P3](../source/v05-c01.md#nw-v05-c01-p0003)_

## Personality

Anne is an enthusiastic, talkative, and highly imaginative girl who tends to fling herself into her pursuits heart and soul. She is capable of intense devotions as well as fiery, long-held grudges. Though reckless and careless at times, she possesses a strong sense of responsibility, courage, and generosity.

_Sources: [v1 c12 P46](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0046), [v1 c13 P0](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0000), [v1 c15 P13](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0013), [v1 c17 P36](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0036), [v1 c19 P30](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0030), [v1 c19 P74](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0074), [v1 c24 P10](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0010), [v2 c2 P33](../source/v02-c02.md#nw-v02-c02-p0033)_

## History

Anne Shirley arrived at Green Gables at the age of eleven to live as an adopted orphan with Marilla and Matthew Cuthbert. She formed a deep bond of friendship with Diana Barry and developed an academic rivalry with Gilbert Blythe after he angered her at school. Encouraged by her teacher Miss Stacy, Anne attended Queen's Academy, gained her teaching license, and later taught school in Avonlea and Valley Road while organizing the Avonlea Village Improvement Society. She pursued higher education at Redmond College alongside close friends Priscilla Grant and Philippa Gordon, living at Patty's Place. Eventually, she married Dr. Blythe, traveled to Europe for a medical congress, and became a mother of six children, residing at Ingleside in Glen St. Mary.

_Sources: [v1 c6 P17](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0017), [v1 c12 P35](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0035), [v1 c15 P32](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0032), [v1 c17 P36](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0036), [v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001), [v1 c34 P11](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0011), [v2 c4 P1](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0001), [v2 c6 P8](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0008), [v3 c4 P2](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0002), [v3 c5 P2](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0002), [v3 c16 P0](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0000), [v3 c31 P1](../source/v03-c31.md#nw-v03-c31-p0001), [v5 c1 P1](../source/v05-c01.md#nw-v05-c01-p0001), [v5 c1 P3](../source/v05-c01.md#nw-v05-c01-p0003)_
